recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#F2F2F2). 2. Draw a thin (~1.5pt) dark-red (#8B1A2B) rectangle outline inset about 5% from all slide edges, no fill. 3. Add a centered text box in the middle of the slide with the text 'Linear Classification', bold sans-serif (Arial), ~48pt, color #C8102E. 4. In the top-right corner (inside the border), draw a small circle (~0.4in diameter) with pale yellow fill (#FFF9A8) and dark navy outline (#2B2B6B, ~1.5pt); place the number '8' centered inside in dark text. 5. Do not include the mouse cursor (it is a recording artifact).
